reference.question: Convert \(18^\circ15^{\prime}36^{\prime\prime}\) to degrees. (Enter only the numerical value; unit: degrees.)
reference.solution:
Method 1: Converting minutes and seconds to degrees

\(15^{\prime}=\frac{15}{60}^\circ=0.25^\circ\) and \(36^{\prime\prime}=\frac{36}{3600}^\circ=0.01^\circ\), so \(18^\circ15^{\prime}36^{\prime\prime}=18.26^\circ\).
